rng_static_audit.definitions: static audit, no execution; all citations re-grepped at run time

process_level_and_independent_rebuild_se.purpose: process-level seeding with args.seed (run.py:298-302) and the independent-run model rebuild reset (run.py:394-395)

phase_init_seed_formula_run_py_407_409.purpose: per-phase init seed formula: independent == args.seed; CL stream phase uses seed + index*10007 -> identical instance at index 0
cited_code: phase_seed = args.seed if args.method == "independent" else args.seed + index * 10007

phase_seed_apply_run_py_408_409.purpose: the phase seed is applied by absolute reset of CPU and CUDA RNG right before expert creation

expert_creation_run_py_412.purpose: expert (LoRA bank) created right after the absolute RNG reset; consumes exactly the reset RNG stream

expert_init_readout_model_py_31_33.purpose: LoRAExpert A init consumes the just-reset torch RNG; B is zeros (RNG-free) (readout_model.py:31-32)

cited_code: router = FeatureRouter(args.router_memory, args.router_ridge, args.router_modality, args.seed) if args.method == "expand" else None

batch_shuffle_run_py_68_70.purpose: deterministic batch shuffle seed: seed + stream_index*1000 + epoch -> identical at index 0 (run.py:61-84)

caption_cycling_data_py_209_212.purpose: caption reference offset: sha256(seed + image identity) + epoch mod len(refs); no stream index term

training_rows_call_run_py_445.purpose: caption/VQA target construction per batch with global args.seed (index-free)

router_memory_subsample_readout_router_p.purpose: router memory subsample generator: deterministic seed; exists only for the expansion router, not the independent adapter

router_randperm_readout_router_py_47_49.purpose: the only torch.randperm in the path; router-only, cannot affect expert weights

replay_buffer_sampling_cl_only_run_py_47.purpose: replay buffer selection (replay_lora only; not on the expand/independent index-0 path)

deterministic_algorithms_run_py_290_297.purpose: deterministic kernels + cuBLAS workspace configured before the first CUDA Matmul

eval_dropout_disabled_readout_model_py_1.purpose: train() forces all pretrained/encoder networks to eval: BLIP dropout consumes no RNG even while LoRA trains

cited_code: model_rows = [dict(row, image=images[(index + 1) % len(images)]) for index, row in enumerate(rows)]

rng_static_audit.dataloader_worker_statement: No torch DataLoader, num_workers or worker_init_fn exists in either audited file: training batches are explicit Python lists (epoch_batches), and feature/generation micro-batches are synchronous fixed-order lists; only the three process-level RNGs (python, numpy, torch+cuda) plus the local Random/Generator instances above consume or seed randomness on resume.

Its native counterpart at the same stage is verified equal to the original G4 training-time evaluation, so the diagonal timing itself is grounded by shipped evidence, and no substitute oracle was used.

oracle_grouping_by_stream_index.group_definition_note: 묶임 정의: 동일 (task, stream position, seed) 집합 안에서 두 order의 oracle diag/final corpus 점수가 float 수준으로 정확히 같은 값 하나로 묶이는지 검사한다. stream position이 다르면 초기화 seed 공식(seed + index*10007)과 shuffle seed 공식(seed + index*1000 + epoch) 때문에 값이 달라지는 것이 정상이며, 두 집합을 같은 그룹으로 묶지 않는다.

k_decomposition_recheck.first_task_slice_note: 1-B가 검사하는 첫 task 조건은 이 분해 K(=O_diag − I)의 position 0 슬라이스이며, 첫 task 셀 자체는 diagonal 셀 절에서 독립적으로 계산한다.

conclusions.korean: 첫 task(position 0) 조건에서 학습-즉시 대각선 task-ID oracle과 independent 첫 평가가 16셀(V, orders V_C_G_F·V_G_C_F) 및 16셀(F, orders F_G_C_V·F_C_G_V) 모두에서 예측 문자열 512/512 전체 동일 + 저장된 corpus 점수 차이 0.0(raw·normalized 동시)으로 O=I 성립.

evidence.grounded_cause: 초기화/셔플/caption 사이클 공식이 index=0에서 동일 인스턴스 + expert0↔independent adapter bitwise 동일(rng_static_audit, checkpoint_zip_parity)

conclusions.diagonal_oracle_artifact: The training-immediate (diagonal) task-ID oracle exists as a saved artifact: G5 re-evaluated every bank at each stream stage with frozen experts, and each first-task cell has task_id_oracle/predictions_after_00_<task>.jsonl with 512 aligned rows (this script asserts file presence, row counts and ID alignment). Its native counterpart at the same stage is verified equal to the original G4 training-time evaluation, so the diagonal timing itself is grounded by shipped evidence, and no substitute oracle was used.

conclusions.topic: ZIP storage expert0 vs independent adapter
conclusions.korean: ZIP storage만으로 비교: 첫 task expert 192개 tensor×4,718,592 bytes가 independent adapter와 32/32 셀 bitwise 전부 동일(max|Δ|=0.0; independent archive/latest 두 형태 상호 일치) → 파라미터 수준에서도 O=I 성립.

caption 묶임 성립: COCO(position 1: V_C_G_F·F_C_G_V, position 2: F_G_C_V·V_G_C_F)와 Flickr(position 0: F_G_C_V·F_C_G_V, position 3: V_C_G_F·V_G_C_F)에서 동일 (task, stream position, seed) 그룹의 두 order oracle diag/final corpus 점수가 float 수준으로 정확히 같은 값 하나로 묶이며(diag==final 전부 포함) C·F 각 16 셀(총 32) 전부에서 성립. position 간 값은 초기화 seed 공식(seed + index*10007)/shuffle seed 공식(seed + index*1000 + epoch)의 코드 근거로 달라지며, 그 달라짐도 8 seed 각각에서 같은 그룹 값을 가진다.
conclusions.note: 점수는 G5 routing_audit의 저장 matrix 값; scorer 재실행 없음.

conclusions.korean: VQA 동일 검사: V(position 0: V_C_G_F·V_G_C_F, position 3: F_G_C_V·F_C_G_V), G(position 1: F_G_C_V·V_G_C_F, position 2: V_C_G_F·F_C_G_V)에서 동일 그룹의 두 order oracle diag/final 점수가 float 수준으로 정확히 같아 VQA에서도 묶임 성립.
K(4.4절 O_diag−I 잔차)의 index-0 슬라이스는 32/32 셀에서 정확히 0.0이다. 전체 family 잔차(VQA -0.022366, caption +0.004291)는 index>0에 남으며 초기화·셔플 seed 차이와 양립하는 실행 잔차로 보아야 하고, 그 차이의 인과 기여나 파라미터 전이 손상을 이번 조회만으로 확정할 수 없다.
불일치/문장 불일치가 관측되어도 원인을 GPU 비결정론으로 단정하지 않는다. 관측된 크기·개수와 코드 인용 근거만 기록하며, 국지적 원인 규명은 1-D(재생성) 범위로 남긴다.
